summary: This video breaks down the top player team compositions and rankings from the Chinese server for Week 2 of Continental Challenge in Season 9. Players require four specialized teams, with top competitors achieving over 7 billion total damage across bosses like Stegamoffyn, Guinavivre, and Synarell. Aura remains the dominant damage setup hitting between 2.3B and 3.6B, while Corrosion and Dauntless form reliable secondary teams. Notably, Toxin teams utilizing Sleight, Serpentemis, and Rhyviel heavily outperform Wild against Guinavivre, while Synarell requires multi-school lineups to trigger a 50% damage vulnerability.

teams.note: Top scoring Aura team delivering 2.3B to 3.6B damage, featuring Anneliesis on Secrecy and Rena on Puppeteer.
Corrosion team reaching 1.7B+ damage; Reytah can replace Sia and Sacredeia can be substituted as needed.
Toxin team vs Guinavivre reaching 872M at I0 and over 1.1B at I5, utilizing Rhyviel as a tank with Mystic Conch.
Dauntless physical composition vs Stegamoffyn capable of delivering roughly 1.9B damage.
Ice Blast team achieving 1.55B damage as a strong alternative to Dauntless on Stegamoffyn.
Thunderbolt team vs Synarell incorporating heroes from three distinct schools to trigger a 50% damage bonus.

meta_changes: Aura remains the undisputed highest single-team damage archetype in Continental Challenge, exceeding 3.5B damage.
Toxin teams utilizing Sleight and Serpentemis have superseded Wild teams on Guinavivre, breaking 1.1B damage.
New Corrosion hero Rhyviel is cross-viable in Toxin comps as an effective tank DPS with Mystic Conch.
The Synarell encounter mechanics favor mixing heroes from three different element schools for a 50% damage increase.
tips: Forge the Raging Wildfire - Helm+ (Converging Flames set) because it is widely shared across Aura, Dauntless, and Corrosion damage dealers.
Use a Toxin team instead of Wild to counter Guinavivre in Continental Challenge for much higher damage output even at low inspiration.
Equip rotation enablers like Child of Chaos and Rena with the Puppeteer set to cycle ultimate skills rapidly.
When tackling Synarell, combine your primary damage dealers with supports from two separate schools to trigger the 50% damage increase.
